svg.title: Charter
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Museum painting photo explicitly identified as Charter (1959), Yale with gift provenance. Foundation’s 1959 Sixteen Americans exhibition also names Charter, EK 226. Rounded orange quadrilateral on white upper field above black lower rectangle. Physical dimensions unresolved in current primary record; normalized to photograph. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of orange; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
